_comment: Advisories the frontend dependency gate (tools/check_npm_audit.py) tolerates. Every entry needs a rationale and an expiry; an expired entry fails the gate. Remove an entry as soon as a fix exists.

advisories.reason: Stack exhaustion on deeply nested brace patterns. No patched release exists (affected range '*', latest 3.0.3). Reached only through tailwindcss and vite-plugin-singlefile at build time, on this repo's own source globs; nothing from the braces chain ships in the bundle or runs in the desktop app.

Quadratic-time selector parsing (fixed in 7.1.6). tailwindcss 3.x and postcss-nested pin the 6.x line, so it cannot be upgraded without moving Tailwind. Build-time only, parsing this repo's own CSS; not shipped.
